doctor: what's your name and where are you from
patient: Will Hughes, from Cardiff originally, but I live in Brussels now, Rue Haute in the Marolles
doctor: and what's going on
patient: I get these headaches on one side, behind the right eye, like a hot needle, every night at the same time for weeks, then nothing for months
doctor: does your eye water
patient: yes it waters and the nose runs on that side, I can't lie still, I walk up and down the hall
doctor: I will ask about alcohol
patient: a pint sets it off straight away during a bad spell
doctor: any other doctor seen this
patient: a neurologist at Saint-Luc, Professor Lambert, he mentioned oxygen
doctor: and a phone number in case the results come back early
patient: +32 470 98 76 54
